credibility.line: Only one promise can be checked against reported numbers so far — too few to score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Management targets 200 bps EBITDA margin expansion, but reported EBITDA margin remained flat at 20.0% in FY24, FY25, and FY26.
Management claimed strong Domino's performance, but LFL growth decelerated from 9.1% in Q2 FY26 to 2.5% in Q1 FY27.
Operating cash flow reached ₹1894 crore in FY26, supporting cash generation claims with OCF/PAT of 4.27.
Sep 2026 PAT dropped 42.6% YoY to ₹112 crore despite revenue increasing 11.5% YoY to ₹2608 crore.

bull: FY26 operating cash flow reached ₹1894 crore with strong 5-year cash conversion of 3.56.
Consolidated revenue increased 17.4% YoY in FY26 to ₹9513 crore.
Popeyes LFL growth accelerated to 45% in Q1 FY27.
bear: EBITDA margin remained stuck at 20.0% in FY24, FY25, and FY26.
Domino's LFL growth slowed to 2.5% in Q1 FY27.
D/E ratio rose to 2.14 in Mar 2026 with borrowings reaching ₹4902 crore.
watch: Domino's LFL growth trajectory in Q2 FY27.
FY27 capex spend against ₹750-900 crore guidance.
